title: Perfect

title: Simple and effective
body:
I've tried multiple habit trackers, but HabitKit is the only one that I've continued to use, as it simply just works great and actually helps me keep the motivation!
The simple UI helps a lot in this regard, as it's not distracting or confusing to use
author: Peter Brinck

title: Best habitminder
body: Best habitminder I have yet to try… only missing multiple daily notifications for each habit but that is not enough to not deserve 5 stars :-)
author: JTCHlife
